ValidationRule.description: BOPI-528 Fields required for Advanced Approval email templates except for the ones on Required_for_Legal_Additional which are all related to the contract. BOPI-600 updated to prevent auto renewals from stopping
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', $Profile.Name <> "B - Looker", $User.Alias <> "Workato", Pricebook2.Name = 'CPQ', Probability > 0.80, OR( ISBLANK(SBQQ__PrimaryQuote__c), ISBLANK(Account.Client_Legal_Entity_Name__c), OR( AND( RecordType.DeveloperName <> "Healthcare", ISBLANK(Ship_To_Account__c) ), AND( ISPICKVAL(SBQQ__PrimaryQuote__r.Multiple_Ship_to_Accounts__c,"No"), ISBLANK(Ship_To_Account__c) ) ), ISPICKVAL(Type,""), ISBLANK(TEXT(SBQQ__PrimaryQuote__r.Multiple_Ship_to_Accounts__c)) ), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Type, "Auto Renewal")) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The following fields are required: On Account: - 'Client Legal Entity Name' On the Primary Quote: - 'Multiple Ship to Accounts' On Opportunity: - 'Type'
